main_text.p: per Christum confidere, ut roborati fortitudine Spiritus Sancti, super aspides calcent & basiliscos, omnemque virtutem inimici pedibus subjectam conterant. Versetur spes illorum, non in opulento splendore basilicarum & oratoriorum comparando, sed in desiderio coelestium mansionum ferveat. Nos quoque, illorum imbecillitati in hac parte precibus nostris succurramus, jugiter orantes, ut Deus omnis spei & consolationis, impleat eos omni gaudio & pace in credendo sibique applicando merito & promisso Christi, ut exuberent in spe salutis, per potentiam Spiritus Sancti. Ornent se sponso suo Christo, ejus indies adventum praestolantes: possideant animas suas, in doctrina[?], patientia & consolatione Scripturarum, quae ab ore & aure eorum nunquam recedentes, in salutare alimentum animae vertentur. Respicientes enim continue ad omnia praecepta Domini, pudore non afficientur: nam haec debiles confirmabunt, caecis visum restituet, pedibus lumen praebebunt: bona autem verba & consolatoria, quae depromit afflictis Deus, erunt ipsis tanquam nix aestivo fervore reperta, & veluti rivus frigidus siticulosis, quo sustentabitur illorum spiritus, donec peragrato

page.notes: The scan is slightly blurred at the lower left of the text block; the word after "in" (printed as "doctrina" with a mark between "in" and the word) is marked [?]. The page number is printed in old-style form "12ʒ" and is given as 123. The running head is set in spaced capitals, given as AD INDOS. The text begins mid-paragraph, continued from the previous page. The last line is cut off by the catchword "hujus" on the right.
